stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: I wrote my own log. It will not go.
stations.note: He typed it in last night.

stations.title: The compiler
stations.text: Refuses the file and points at lines

stations.title: Boat log
stations.text: The day written down, to the last line.

captions: Ossian wrote a program of his own overnight: a log of the boat's day.
The compiler refuses it, and once it runs, it stops with an exception on a foggy day.
You read what javac and java say, and fix each of his four slips.
Now the log compiles, runs, and writes the day to its last line.
Reading errors. Next, the program learns to do the same thing many times.
